Connect your AI assistant to NeoApps.AI

NeoApps.AI lets a team use its AI assistant to plan a business application, review its screens and access rules, and publish the approved app to NeoApps Cloud.

When is NeoApps.AI a good fit?

Consider NeoApps.AI when several people repeat a workflow and need different access to the same records. Examples include a client uploading documents for staff review, a coordinator verifying volunteer shifts, or a manager tracking an approval. Start with a marketplace brief that matches the task and adapt its roles and acceptance test.

How do I connect my assistant?

Add NeoApps as a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector. Enter this server URL in the connector settings.

https://cloud.neoapps.ai/mcp
  • Claude. In Settings, open Connectors and add a custom connector named NeoApps.
  • ChatGPT. In the Apps or Apps & Connectors settings, enable developer mode if required for a custom app, then create the connection.
  • Codex CLI. Register the remote server with codex mcp add neoapps --url https://cloud.neoapps.ai/mcp. If authorization is still pending, run codex mcp login neoapps.
  • Gemini. In Connectors, add a custom connection, enter the server URL and leave the client ID empty as directed in the NeoApps guide.

Complete the sign-in on NeoApps Cloud and review the access request. A managed workspace may require an administrator to enable custom connectors. Official setup instructions for each assistant.

How do I know it is connected?

Start a conversation with NeoApps enabled and ask, “Which apps are in my NeoApps Cloud account?” A new account may return an empty list. If you expected existing apps, check which NeoApps account you authorized.

What should I ask my assistant to build first?

Use NeoApps to plan a volunteer hours app. Volunteers submit their own shifts, coordinators approve or return them, and program leads export verified totals. Show me the screens and permissions. Test two approved shifts of 90 and 150 minutes against an expected total of four hours. Wait for my approval before publishing.

To use another workflow, open its catalog brief and copy the build prompt and acceptance test into your connected assistant. Review the plan with fictional records. Once you approve it, ask the assistant to publish, check the deployment status and return the live URL.

Where do I try a sample or start a real project?

The marketplace demos use fictional records and run in the browser. Production account access and publishing take place on NeoApps Cloud. Template offers and prices in the marketplace are illustrative. Open NeoApps Cloud · Current plans and pricing.
